subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Pareto Principle at Work
description: A quick, practical guide to The Pareto Principle at Work.

hook.text: Italian economist Vilfredo Pareto noticed 80% of Italy's land was owned by 20% of the population.

buildup.text: The 80/20 rule repeats everywhere: 80% of your results come from 20% of your efforts in most contexts.

discovery.text: Finding your high-leverage 20% means identifying which tasks produce outsized results relative to time spent.

twist.text: Most people spread effort evenly. Top performers identify the vital few and pour energy there instead.

climax.text: List your ten tasks. Circle the two that create the most value. Build your day around those two first.

punchline.text: Find the vital 20%. Give it your best hours.

quiz.question: What does the Pareto Principle suggest about work output?
options: All tasks contribute equally to results
A small portion of efforts produces most results
Working more hours always increases output
